status: Design review before edits; not implemented.
node_tags: Append new HCP4 point node tags after13; existing wire tags and authored version3 encoding remain readable.
dependency_replay: Prior point records have already been constructed and checked under STRICT. Factor the point owner so the graph decoder can reuse those checked immutable dependencies while rechecking the current map, fiber, similarity or line-intersection construction. Keep the existing public into_point recursive validation for arbitrary callers; no serialized flag or pointer establishes validity.
memoization: Extend owned point storage keys to Polynomial Arc, Similarity Arc and AlgebraicChordPair Arc. Existing point cache stores owning CurvePoint2 clones. Native root/source keys remain owned and local.
traversal: Use an explicit Visit/Emit stack for recursive point encoding so shared dependency graphs do not become expression trees. Validate known record depth before reusing dependencies or calling constructors. Decoder remains prior-reference iteration.
resource_proposal: Add an explicit SvgOptions.max_point_definition_depth (default256, zero allows existing leaf definitions). Count nested RationalImage/Similarity/SupportingLineIntersection point constructions; leaf definitions have depth0. Propagate depth through chord/support/range and curve-endpoint records so indirection cannot reset the limit. Reject before constructing a node whose derived depth exceeds the configured bound, using SizeOverflow with a distinct depth-limit label; test small budget and larger retry. This does not bound total arithmetic, coefficient growth or heap bytes. Document the public option and new record tags as a migration.
fiber_codec: Retain equation coefficient rows, selected base parameter, lower/upper second-coordinate selector and optional exact-root witness. Do not serialize a trusted root-count certificate: request a singleton and revalidate it through PolynomialPoint2::from_fiber, preserving half-open interval and exact-witness rules.
map_codec: Retain both numerator polynomials and original shared denominator including removable factors; replay through RationalMap2 and checked source.rational_image.
similarity_codec: Retain six exact affine entries and re-establish similarity through try_from_real_affine; do not trust stored scale/orientation or use finite affine reconstruction.
hard_case: The original complete selected fillet remains circle-replay-next-baseline.rs with its positive final assertion. point-replay-next-baseline.rs isolates its first line piece; completion of this point increment alone cannot be reported as completion of circle replay.
projection_review: If replay tests expose cache-dependent projection for newly admitted composite point forms, reproduce it on the unchanged parent and fix the owning bound/projection path; do not reduce full-SVG equality to metadata-only equality.
parent: S is still in final qualification. T must be reparented to the eventual S commit without modifying T implementation bytes, then reproduce the original parent baseline before final qualification.
